name: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Slope Corrector
tagline: SLOPE CORRECTOR FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM
summary: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Slope Corrector is an accessory used to accommodate slope corrections arising from falls created on concrete surfaces for drainage purposes. Slope correctors are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), while fire-rated slope correctors area manufactured from reinforced thermoplastics, and can correct for slopes of 1% to 5%. SikaRoof® VersiJack® Slope Corrector is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® and is installed between the top of pedestals and beneath the pavers.
